title: Marupes NSS demolish Valmiera to take LJBL U19 Boys crown as fourth seeds
description: Fourth-seeded Marupes NSS pulled off the upset of the Swedbank LJBL U19 Boys finals on Sunday, overwhelming second-seeded Bertanu Valmieras BS 93-76 behind a devastating team effort that featured four players scoring 19 or more points. Coach Davis Coders' side trailed 16-19 after the first quarter but seized control from the second period onward, outscoring Valmiera 31-19 in the second quarter to take a 47-38 halftime lead and never looking back.
imageCaption: Marupes NSS demolish Valmiera to take LJBL U19 Boys crown as fourth seeds-May 10, 2026

title: RBS DSN claim U19 League title
description: FINALRBS DSN - Marupe 83-77 Forward Kristers Skrinda (200-2006) stepped up with a double-double by scoring 21 points and 12 rebounds for the winners and Markuss Graudins chipped in 16 points. RBS DSN's coach Martins Fomins used entire bench which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games. At the losing side guard Jekabs Niedra (184-2006) responded with 25 points and 4 assists and forward Roberts Ciganskis (197-2006) produced a double-double by scoring 14 points and 10 rebounds. Five Marupe players scored in double figures.
imageCaption: RBS DSN claim U19 League title (Photo: basket.lv)

title: BJBS/AK VEF clinch U19 League title
description: Edvards Egle (190-2005) stepped up and scored 21 points, 7 rebounds and 6 assists for the winners and Rudolfs Svitins (200-2005) chipped in 16 points and 7 rebounds. Four BJBS/AK VEF players scored in double figures. At the losing side guard Janis Censonis (185-2005) responded with 20 points, 6 rebounds and 5 assists and guard Krisjanis Petersons (190-2006) scored 22 points and 7 rebounds. Ventspils Spars: P.Krisjanis 22+7reb+2ast, C.Janis 20+6reb+5ast, S.Toms 17+6reb+3ast, D.Rudis 6+9reb+1ast, B.Ricards 3+2reb, L.Markuss 2+1ast
imageCaption: BJBS/AK VEF clinch U19 League title (Photo: basket.lv)

title: U19 League Round 1 of Finals. Riga/DSN claim the title
description: Riga/DSN dominated down low during the game scoring 58 of its points in the paint compared to Riga/Bball clas' 36. Riga/DSN forced 25 Riga/Bball clas turnovers. Riga/Bball clas were plagued by 24 personal fouls down the stretch. Worth to mention a great performance of guard Kristofers Karlsons (185-2004) who helped to win the game recording a double-double by scoring 20 points, 13 rebounds, 8 assists and 4 steals. Forward Karlis Vavers (196-2006) contributed with a double-double by scoring 15 points, 12 rebounds and 5 assists (perfect from the field making all six shots) for the winners. Four Riga/DSN players scored in double figures. Guard Markuss Mamajs (180-2004) answered with a double-double by scoring 29 points, 11 rebounds, 6 assists and 4 steals and Rihards Berkolds (192-2004) added 32 points and 6 assists in the effort for Riga/Bball clas.

title: Ogre celebrate U19 League title
description: FINALRiga/DSN - Ogre 70-76 Ogre had a 37-24 advantage in offensive rebounds. Worth to mention a great performance of guard Davids Mals (187-2004) who helped to win the game recording 25 points and 6 rebounds. Markuss Lastis contributed with 16 points and 5 rebounds for the winners. Forward Rolands Dizgalvis (198-2003) answered with a double-double by scoring 16 points and 11 rebounds and guard Juris Vitols (187-2005) added 12 points, 9 rebounds, 4 assists and 7 steals in the effort for Riga/DSN. Four Riga/DSN players scored in double figures. Both coaches used bench players which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games.
imageCaption: Ogre celebrate U19 League title (Photo: basket.lv)
